name: prometheus.exporter.kafka

arguments.name: kafka_uris
arguments.description: Address array (host:port) of Kafka server.

arguments.name: allow_auto_topic_creation
arguments.description: If true, the broker may auto-create topics that you requested which don’t already exist.

arguments.name: allow_concurrency
arguments.description: If set to true, all scrapes trigger Kafka operations. Otherwise, they share results. WARNING: Disable this on large clusters.

arguments.name: ca_file
arguments.description: The optional certificate authority file for TLS client authentication.

arguments.name: cert_file
arguments.description: The optional certificate file for TLS client authentication.

arguments.name: groups_exclude_regex
arguments.description: Regex that determines which consumer groups to exclude.

arguments.name: groups_filter_regex
arguments.description: Regex filter for consumer groups to be monitored.

arguments.name: gssapi_kerberos_auth_type
arguments.description: Kerberos auth type. Either keytabAuth or userAuth.

arguments.name: gssapi_kerberos_config_path
arguments.description: Kerberos configuration path.

arguments.name: gssapi_key_tab_path
arguments.description: Kerberos keytab file path.

arguments.name: gssapi_realm
arguments.description: Kerberos realm.

arguments.name: gssapi_service_name
arguments.description: Service name when using Kerberos Authorization

arguments.name: insecure_skip_verify
arguments.description: If set to true, the server’s certificate isn’t checked for validity. This makes your HTTPS connections insecure.

arguments.name: instance
arguments.description: Theinstancelabel for metrics, default is the hostname:port of the first kafka_uris. You must manually provide the instance value if there is more than one string in kafka_uris.

arguments.name: kafka_cluster_name
arguments.description: Kafka cluster name.

arguments.name: kafka_version
arguments.description: Kafka broker version.

arguments.name: key_file
arguments.description: The optional key file for TLS client authentication.

arguments.name: max_offsets
arguments.description: The maximum number of offsets to store in the interpolation table for a partition.

arguments.name: metadata_refresh_interval
arguments.description: Metadata refresh interval.

arguments.name: offset_show_all
arguments.description: If true, the broker may auto-create topics that you requested which don’t already exist.

arguments.name: prune_interval_seconds
arguments.description: Deprecated (no-op), use metadata_refresh_interval instead.

arguments.name: sasl_disable_pafx_fast
arguments.description: Configure the Kerberos client to not use PA_FX_FAST.

arguments.name: sasl_mechanism
arguments.description: The SASL SCRAM SHA algorithm SHA256 or SHA512 as mechanism.

arguments.name: sasl_password
arguments.description: SASL user password.

arguments.name: sasl_username
arguments.description: SASL user name.

arguments.name: tls_server_name
arguments.description: Used to verify the hostname on the returned certificates unless tls.insecure-skip-tls-verify is given. If you don’t provide the Kafka server name, the hostname is taken from the URL.

arguments.name: topic_workers
arguments.description: Minimum number of topics to monitor.

arguments.name: topics_exclude_regex
arguments.description: Regex that determines which topics to exclude.

arguments.name: topics_filter_regex
arguments.description: Regex filter for topics to be monitored.

arguments.name: use_sasl_handshake
arguments.description: Only set this to false if using a non-Kafka SASL proxy.

arguments.name: use_sasl
arguments.description: Connect using SASL/PLAIN.

arguments.name: use_tls
arguments.description: Connect using TLS.

arguments.name: use_zookeeper_lag
arguments.description: If set to true, use a group from zookeeper.

arguments.name: zookeeper_uris
arguments.description: Address array (hosts) of zookeeper server.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
